buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders shall fulfill the following qualifying criteria and upload valid documentary proof in support of their eligibility along with the bid:- 1. Local Presence Requirement :- The Bidder/Service Provider shall have a registered office in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and the vehicle should be deployed in Car Nicobar. Valid documentary proof indicating the registered office ad dress in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands shall be uploaded with the bid. 2. Vehicle Validity and Statutory Documents :- All vehicles proposed to be deployed under the contract shall possess valid statutory documents, inclu ding a Registration Certificate (RC) indicating commercial/taxi registration corresponding to the vehicl e class specified in the bid. Copies of permits/licenses/clearances such as Fitness Certificate, PUC, full comprehensive insurance, road permit, Registration Certificate, as per the Motor Vehicles Act, RTO an d other applicable laws and statutory bodies, for providing commercial vehicles for this service shall b e uploaded with the bid. 3. Vehicle Ownership/Authorization :- The vehicle(s) offered for deployment shall either be registered in the name of the bidding firm or be s upported by valid authorization from the registered owner permitting the bidder to deploy/use the veh icle(s) for execution of the contract. Documentary proof of ownership or a valid affidavit/Power of Attor ney/lease agreement/NOC or other legally valid authorization from the registered owner shall be uploa ded with the bid. 4. Past Performance/Experience :- The Bidder shall have successfully executed similar vehicle hiring/service contracts during the last two (02) years preceding the date of bid submission. The bidder shall upload Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate (SDAC), Work Completion Certificate, or equivalent documentary evidence issued by the co ncerned client/organization in support of the experience claimed. 5. Statutory and Tax Registrations :- The Bidder shall possess a valid GST Registration applicable to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and a Permanent Account Number (PAN) in the legal name of the bidding entity. Copies of the GST Registr ation Certificate and PAN Card shall be uploaded. The name of the bidding entity in the submitted doc uments shall correspond with the name of the bidder participating in the bid. 6. Non-Blacklisting/Non-Debarment Undertaking :- The Bidder shall not have been blacklisted, debarred or banned by any Central Government Departme nt, State Government Department/UT Administration, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), or Autonomou s Body during the last three (03) years preceding the date of bid submission. A self-declaration/undert aking to this effect, duly signed by the authorized signatory of the bidding firm and furnished on the fir m's letterhead, shall be uploaded with the bid. 7. Timely Reporting and Fuel :- The vehicle deployed under the contract shall report at the designated location at the scheduled time and shall have sufficient fuel to perform the assigned duty. 8. Parking of Vehicle after Duty Hours :- The vehicle deployed under the contract shall be parked at the Buyer's/User's designated premises aft

er completion of duty hours, if so directed by the Buyer/User. In such cases, the vehicle shall not be re moved from the designated premises without the prior written permission of the authorized represent ative of the Buyer/User. The Service Provider/Driver shall comply with all security and parking instructi ons issued by the Buyer/User. 9. Driver's License and Experience :- The driver deployed with the vehicle shall possess a valid and appropriate Driving License issued by th e competent authority for the category of vehicle being deployed. The driver shall have a minimum of 02 (two) years of relevant driving experience. A copy of the valid Driving License and documentary pr oof of the driver's experience shall be furnished to the Buyer/User whenever required. 10. Driver's Mobile Communication and Availability :- The driver deployed with the vehicle shall possess a functional mobile phone with a valid mobile numb er and shall remain reachable during the entire period of duty. The Service Provider shall provide the d river's mobile number to the Buyer/User before commencement of the service and shall immediately i nform the Buyer/User of any change in the driver or contact number. .
